answer.answer: The Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) helps women in low-income countryside homes replace smoke-producing solid cooking materials with bottled gas [E01]. Launched in May 2016 by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, the scheme provides free LPG connections to rural and deprived households that were traditionally using firewood, coal, and cow-dung cakes [E01]. The initiative aims to promote clean cooking fuel like LPG among rural families, which reduces health risks for women and minimizes environmental pollution [E03].
